file.description:
The file that contains the links to be resolved.

This field is provided by DocumentationRenderer before starting to render links for a particular documentation
file.

endpoint.description: The endpoint from the perspective of the browser (Console instance).

title:
To implement `c3ShowType` rendering in the Console content area (as opposed to using the documentation micro-site),
we use a custom link builder that generates calls to `c3ShowType` / `c3ShowFunc` as appropriate.
name: Console.DocLinkBuilder
